target.edition: original PC 1.0.8, not Director’s Cut or DS2

original_selected_draws.overlay: Coverage of the large moss patch underfoot verified.
Empty material overlay; visible contribution not established.

original_submission_totals.scope: Only the four selected draw events, not the whole frame or all vegetation.

pipeline_state.geometry_shrink: saturate((viewZ+8)*(-1/14))*0.1 along negative normalized normal; UV-conditioned for part of the mesh. Shading normal is separately adjusted. No triangle-count reduction.

placement_analysis.status: Static interpretation of captured package bytecode, not matched to the four moss instances.
placement_analysis.input: Already generated candidate positions, terrain normals and raw PointID bits.
placement_analysis.algorithm: xorshift32 with shifts 13,17,5; perturbs rotation, uniform scale and elevation; builds instance transforms and packed bounds.

culling_evidence.observed: Frame shader reads Instances/Bounds/Lods/Setups/Matrices/Streaming/OcclusionTexture and writes FadeStates/CountersAndVisibleInstances with wave operations.
culling_evidence.unresolved: The four moss instances are not individually traced through this path. Web CPU hierarchy and A/B LOD controls are experiments, not recovered original HISM or an established LOD chain.

comparison_result.interpretation: Fewer submissions with the same geometry, not a measured doubling of performance.

visual_scope: Original camera, selected original meshes and four transforms. Simplified lighting at exposure 2; no terrain, rocks or character. No full material or per-pixel visual equivalence claim.
redistribution: Analyst summaries and media only. No raw game models, texture resources, bytecode or executable code.
